thread:
auditor: Hi team — during the SOC 2 review we need three things related to the Jan 12 customer auth outage and key management controls: 1) KMS key rotation artifacts (signed rotation events) from 2025-11-01 -> 2026-02-01, 2) HSM access/audit logs for the same window (including operator IDs and export hashes), and 3) a minimal reproducible test-case and the corresponding API/access logs that show the 401/latency behavior reported by the customer. Please include retention policy references and a short timeline of actions taken. Need by EOD Monday.

jamie_h: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate KMS & HSM pulls. tagging @maria_g and @samir to help with the repro/log slices. Can you confirm the exact time ranges you want for the Jan 12 incident?

auditor: Thanks. For the incident, please include 2026-01-12 00:00 -> 2026-01-13 23:59 UTC (full day). Rotation window as above. Also include sampling approach and any redaction steps applied.

incident-bot: New incident created: INC-2026-0423 "api-auth-401-customer-jan12" — linked to thread.

maria_g: For KMS rotation we have an events feed in the control plane. I can export the rotation events CSV + signed attestations. Example extraction command (internal):
```
redwood-kms export-events --from 2025-11-01 --to 2026-02-01 --types rotation,policy-change --output /tmp/kms-rotations.csv
gpg --output kms-rotations.csv.sig --sign /tmp/kms-rotations.csv
```
I'll redact customer identifiers and provide a mapping doc for the auditor.

samir: For the Jan 12 auth error repro, here's a minimal curl that reproduces the 401 when using a revoked token (we rotate keys weekly, revoked tokens return 401):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <revoked_token_example>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' -v
# expected: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\n# body: {"error":"token_revoked","code":401}
```
I'll slice logs by request_id and timestamp and attach the minimal trace.

samir: quick log sample from proxy (redacted):
```
[2026-01-12T14:32:08Z] req=abc123 user=acct-*** status=401 err="token_revoked" route=/v1/respond latency_ms=12
[2026-01-12T14:32:08Z] authsvc: token-check revoked=true key_id=projects/PLATFORM/keys/rwd-k1
```

leo_w: HSM team — we can export the access ledger. Note that HSM hardware timestamps are monotonic and we also keep an export hash (sha256) per-week for chain-of-custody. Sample HSM extract command (internal):
```
hsmctl export-audit --from 2025-11-01 --to 2026-02-01 --out hsm-audit-2025Q4-2026Q1.jsonl
sha256sum hsm-audit-2025Q4-2026Q1.jsonl > hsm-audit-2025Q4-2026Q1.jsonl.sha256
```
We will scrub session tokens and operator personal emails before upload.

jamie_h: Retention policy summary: API access logs (edge proxy) = 12 months by default, KMS key events / key versions = 24 months, HSM audit ledger = 24 months. We have longer retention available on request (policy appendix 3.2) — I'll attach the policy snippet.

auditor: Are the KMS/HSM logs signed and tamper-evident? Also can you describe the sampling methodology you will use for producing the artifacts? We need to show evidence the sample was chosen without bias.

security_ops: KMS rotation events are signed by the control plane and include a signature block. HSM ledger exports are delivered with weekly sha256 hashes stored in an immutable store (WORM S3 bucket). Sampling approach: we'll provide a deterministic sample using a hash-based selection on request_id (e.g., take requests where sha256(request_id) mod 100 < 10 to get a 10% sample) and include the selection script + seed so auditor can reproduce. We'll include the selection script and the unredacted-to-redacted mapping under controlled access.

jamie_h: Evidence upload plan: I'll put bundles into our secure share at https://secure.redwood.internal/soc2/2026/ (pre-signed links to be generated). Expected artifacts: kms-rotations.csv (+sig), hsm-audit-2025Q4-2026Q1.jsonl (+sha256), auth-log-slices-20260112.zip, retention_policy_3_2.pdf, sampling_script.py. ETA: I'll upload by 2026-01-20 18:00 UTC (auditor deadline was EOD Monday; confirming we can meet that).

auditor: That ETA works. Please include a short human-readable timeline of who did what and when for the Jan 12 incident (ops escalation, key rollback, support comms). Also need assurance that access to the uploaded artifacts is logged and attested.

samir: Timeline stub: 2026-01-12 14:28 UTC — customer reported 401s; 14:30 — incident triage opened (INC-2026-0423); 14:36 — discovered token revocation events; 14:42 — key rollback attempted (no key change performed, rollback aborted); 15:10 — mitigation: issued temporary key to customer; 16:00 — confirmed service restored. I'll fill with exact actor IDs and evidence links in the upload.

security_ops: Access to the SOC bundle will be via pre-signed URLs with short TTL and we will also record all downloads to the auditlog (auditlog export id: AL-2026-77). We'll include a signed attestation that the bundle hasn't been modified after upload.

auditor: Perfect. One last ask — please include the exact repro steps you used and the exact token example metadata (expiry, issued_at, revoked_at) for the sample token so we can map it to events.

samir: Will do. I'll add a small JSON metadata file per sample token: token-example-1.meta.json with fields: issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, key_id, scope. (redacted values in the upload but mapping available under NDA if needed).

jamie_h: I'll start the upload and ping the thread with links + access tokens once ready. tagging @leo_w to confirm HSM export done.

leo_w: HSM export scheduled now, ETA 2 hours. Will post checksum in thread when complete.

auditor: Thanks all — please ping if anything slips. We'll validate the sampling script and the signatures once we have the bundle. :thumbsup:
